title: Retries at every layer multiply; one retrying layer with a budget does not
captions: Each layer makes 1 try plus up to 3 retries: 4 attempts. The database is down. The service tries it 4 times before it gives up.
The gateway also tries the service 4 times. Each of those tries makes 4 database calls. That is 16.
The app tries the gateway 4 times too. One tap now sends up to 64 calls to a database that is already failing. Count attempts, not retries.
The fix: retry in one layer only. The gateway and the service try once and pass the error up. The app retries, so the database gets at most 4 calls.
Add a retry budget. A client retries only while retries stay under 10% of its requests. In a full outage, total load stays near 1.1×, not 4×.
